'''1999 Etten-Leur Challenge Cup''' was a Star Wars CCG challenge cup held in Etten-Leur, Netherlands on 11 July 1999. [[Johan van der Meer]] won it. It is known from Vitor Alves Da Silva's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d26">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-30-etten-leur-netherlands-7-11-99d26/ etten-leur-netherlands-7-11-99], DeckTech (Vitor "Vitor" Alves da Silva, 30 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-30-etten-leur-netherlands-7-11-99d26/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 July 1999
* '''Site:''' Etten-Leur, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 21
* '''Winner:''' [[Johan van der Meer]]
